description: Scalar helper bodies used by the seven-kind host integration. Verified unchanged since first host compile; Bound shape additions do not change these expressions.

functions.combine: inline uint16_t combine(uint16_t residual,uint16_t branch,uint16_t inject){return iq3::bf16_bits(widen(residual)+widen(branch)*(2.f*ng::sigmoid(widen(inject)/4.f)));}
